annotations.title: Check what this connection can reach

description: Whether anything will actually see what you publish, what this credential may do, how much rate budget is left, and what this deployment has enabled. Worth one call before publishing for the first time: if `delivery.canPushWidgets` is false, nothing you publish will be seen by anyone, and the operator needs to install the app and allow notifications rather than you trying again. `attention.liveActivities` names any activity of yours that has stopped telling the operator the truth; it is empty when there is nothing wrong.
name: get_status

liveActivities.description: Activities you own that are not telling the operator the truth. `past-stale-date` means the safety net worked and iOS is already drawing it as out of date, but the run outlived its estimate and needs updating or ending. `no-stale-date` is the dangerous one: nothing will ever mark it stale, so a Lock Screen shows its last state as current indefinitely — send `staleAt` on the next update. Empty when there is nothing to say; activities shared to you are never listed, because you cannot update them.

canPushWidgets.description: False means no device can receive a widget reload: what you publish is stored and seen by nobody.

canStartLiveActivities.description: False means a Live Activity cannot appear on any device.

liveActivityStartTokens.description: Devices a Live Activity start is sent to. Devices that have not run the app in 30 days are not counted and are not sent starts.

liveActivityStartTokensRecentlyActive.description: Of those, devices that have run the app in the last 7 days.

widgetPushApnsDiagnosticsEnabled.description: Whether this deployment is recording the APNs result of each widget reload. Off normally, because every attempt costs a row written.

widgetPushLastDeliveries.description: The latest APNs result per registered widget push token, newest first. Only present while diagnostics are enabled.

apnsId.description: APNs' own id for the push.

attempts.description: How many times this reload was tried before giving up.

reason.description: APNs failure reason, when it failed.

status.description: The HTTP status APNs answered with; 200 is delivered.

tokenPrefix.description: First 8 characters of the push token, enough to tell devices apart.

widgetReloadBurst.description: How many reloads a widget may receive back-to-back after a quiet stretch.

widgetReloadMinSpacingSeconds.description: The shortest gap between two reload pushes to the same widget.

widgetReloadRefillSeconds.description: How often one additional widget reload becomes available.

rateLimits.description: Only windows this account has touched; anything absent has its full allowance.

required.description: Whether writes are refused without an active subscription.
